settings.headline: We build the meters and controls that help cities waste less water.
settings.subtitle: Meridian was founded in Austin in 2014. Today about 550 of us design, build and support Tidemark smart meters, ClearLine filtration controls and Meridian Cloud for more than 140 utilities in North America and Europe.

items.title: Safety first, always
items.text: Anyone can stop the line, pause a rollout or say no to a deadline that isn't safe.

items.title: Every drop counts
items.text: Our customers run public utilities. We treat their water, data and budgets as if they were ours.

items.title: Say it plainly
items.text: Short sentences, real numbers and no jargon, with customers and with each other.

items.title: One team
items.text: Plant, office and remote are one company. We share the wins and fix problems together.

items.name: Austin HQ
items.note: Headquarters for leadership, sales, finance, people, IT and marketing. The 4th floor is being refreshed until the end of November.

items.name: Tulsa plant
items.note: Where every Tidemark meter and ClearLine skid is built and tested. Two shifts, 232 people.

items.name: Denver
items.note: Home of Engineering and the hardware lab, plus customer success for the Mountain West.

items.name: Rotterdam
items.note: Sales, customer success and supply chain for our European customers.

items.name: Remote
items.note: About 60 of us work from home full time, with a trip to an office every quarter.

settings.headline: A fictional company
settings.body: Meridian Waterworks, its people and its products are invented for a Raytha example. Portraits and images are generated, and every email address uses meridian.example.
